title: Add "Alt Mode" option in Settings for Dexcom G6
body:
Can an option be added to the Settings of xDrip that would allow you to connect to the other channel ("Alt Mode" as I have heard it referred to) of the Dexcom G6 transmitter?

This way you can have an iPhone that is connecting to the same Transmitter and it work the same time as xDrip on your Android.

In my case I want to run xDrip on my Android, so it can restart the sensor automatically and get direct numbers while my iPhone runs the Dexcom G6 app with Loop.

comments.body:
@ArkonPhoenix The Dexcom app and xDrip both use the same slot.  That's why you cannot use both to access the same transmitter at the same time.  What slot the Dexcom app uses is not something xDrip can change.
Would you please close this issue?
For sharing experiences and discussing options, you can use the xDrip facebook support group.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or the xDrip room on Gitter.  https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks

You can connect to the other channel.  If you have a Dexcom receiver, it will use the other slot.  If you have a t:slim pump x2, it will use the other slot also.  That's why you can either use a Dexcom receiver or the t:slim pump.
